blocks.text: For what it’s worth, current process on orders above eight servers triggers an onsite inspection by Supermicro. The coast guard’s inspection apparently found the servers by chance, while pursuing an unrelated drug-smuggling case. This inspection happened after Flying Tiger had applied and received a license to purchase 130 servers from Supermicro in Sep 2025 with themselves named as the end user, and passed an onsite inspection at a Chief Telecom datacenter. The inspection was supposed to confirm they had enough rack space and power to fit the servers, but prosecutors claim it’s obvious that the site doesn’t meet these requirements. They didn’t even have a lease signed.
